items.title: Water pollution is a business risk. Here’s how companies can address it
items.summary: The opinions expressed by Trellis expert contributors are their own, not those of Trellis. Poor water quality can pose as great a business risk as water scarcity.

items.title: Nature loss threatens 140 million jobs across Europe, study finds
items.summary: New data from Global Canopy has revealed that 140 million jobs across the European Union (EU), UK and Switzerland are under threat from domestic nature loss, equivalent to 60% of people employed in the region.

items.title: Biodiversity COP17 at the halfway mark: What has been announced so far?
items.summary: The UN’s 17th Conference of the Parties (COP17) to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) has reached the halfway point.

items.title: TODAY: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: Join us on 27 October for an edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: Study: Oil and gas firms committed $59bn to transition-exposed projects in 2025
items.summary: Fossil fuel majors risk locking in stranded assets according to new analysis, with $59bn allocated to projects that are highly vulnerable to transition risks just last year.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Taking place on 5 November, this upcoming webinar will explore how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.

items.title: Win a free VIP pass to edie 27: Take our sustainability snapshot survey
items.summary: Sustainability professionals have the chance to win six months of access to edie’s digital Membership offering as well as a VIP pass to edie 27 in April by completing a short survey.

items.title: UK CBAM: Understanding the risks, managing carbon data and preparing for compliance
items.summary: With the UK’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) set to take effect from January 2027, businesses importing carbon-intensive materials face new financial, regulatory and supply chain obligations.

items.title: Two weeks to go: Turning Scope 3 targets into funded action
items.summary: Join this edie webinar, held in partnership with South Pole on 12 November, to learn more about building the business case for Scope 3.

items.title: NEXT MONTH: How to prepare for the UK SRS
items.summary: This webinar, hosted in partnership with Simply Sustainable on 10 November, will explore how businesses can prepare for the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS), understand their current level of readiness and turn gaps into a practical implementation plan.
